About.bio1: Hello! I'm Fadhil, a Fullstack Developer who enjoys turning complex business workflows into clean, fast, and dependable web applications.
About.bio2: My work spans internal operational systems, centralized authentication portals (SSO), real-time tracking middlewares, and data-driven monitoring dashboards.
About.bio3: I'm comfortable owning the full development lifecycle: designing relational database schemas, building secure and well-structured APIs, and crafting responsive, intuitive interfaces.
